In SCOP 1.69, PA1492 from PDB 1t1j was classified as d1t1ja_/d1t1jb_ with SCCS c.137.1.1: family Hypothetical protein PA1492, superfamily Hypothetical protein PA1492, fold Hypothetical protein PA1492, class c Alpha and beta proteins (a/b). Nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase from PDB 1f8y was classified as d1f8ya_/d1f8yb_ with SCCS c.23.14.1: family N-deoxyribosyltransferase, superfamily N-deoxyribosyltransferase, fold c.23 Flavodoxin-like, also class c. Thus SCOP 1.69 put 1t1j and 1f8y only in the same broad structural class, not in the same fold or superfamily. In current SCOPe 2.08, the PA1492 core domains d1t1ja1 and d1t1jb1 keep SUNIDs 106249 and 106250 but move to c.23.14.2.
